Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! 🌿

Great question. Free Standard shipping applies to orders of **$75 or more, calculated after discounts and before tax**. Since your promo code brings your total down to $70, you wouldn't qualify, and Standard shipping would be **$7.95**.

A couple of options you could consider:

- **Add a little more to your cart:** If you add at least $5 more in items (so your total after the promo is $75 or higher), Standard shipping becomes free.
- **Leafy Plus:** This membership is $59/year and includes free Standard shipping with no minimum. It's probably only worth it if you plan to order from us regularly.

Also, just so you know, Express shipping is $14.95 and is never free.

Let me know if you have any other questions. Happy planting! 🌱
